packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for user acceptance testing: personas with goals, acceptance criteria a person agrees to before any test, scenario scripts, observed results recorded as they happen, every defect proposed as a finding, and a person's go or no-go kept as a noun.

packs.title: Video editing
packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for editing a video from its script: an edit decision list, a cut paced against the words spoken over it, J and L cuts, b-roll placement, transitions, colour and contrast consistency, an audio mix with ducking and loudness targets, reframing for other aspect ratios, and a conform and export spec, with every revision kept and a person locking the cut.

packs.title: Video and motion with code
packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for video and motion made with code: tested code shipped in the pack and pinned by digest, scene recipes, a procedural asset catalog, motion formulas, aspect, caption and audio rules, every-frame and post-encode checks, a demo sequence, media and tool cards, with verbs to seek frames, fit motion, draft, compile and check scenes, and plan, render and check a video.

packs.title: Video QA checks
packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for automated checks on an encoded video beyond the eight post-encode checks: blank and frozen frames, cut cadence, loudness range and true peak, clipping and silence gaps, caption timing against speech, caption line length and reading speed, safe areas, the file's delivery spec read from its own boxes, and a legibility proxy for rendered text, each measured on the exact bytes with tested standard-library code.

packs.title: Video review
packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for reviewing a video with a fixed rubric, run by a person or a worker that did not make it: panels of the exact bytes at the sizes people watch on, every number traced to its evidence, timestamped findings with a severity, the evidence seen and the verb that would fix each one, a second opinion where reviewers disagree, a person who watches and listens, and a re-review of the fixed cut.

packs.title: Video showcase
packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for making a truthful demo video: script, storyboard, shot list, capture plan, audio cue sheet, styles, captions, evidence links and showcase checks, with verbs from script to review and the owner's publication record; scenes, assembly, rendering and encoded-video checks use the video and motion pack.

packs.title: Video audience acceptance
packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for testing whether a video's intended viewers understand it: named audience segments, video-specific tasks such as saying what it does after one viewing, pass criteria fixed before any session, consented sessions a person runs, answers scored by two scorers, a decision that never generalizes beyond the people asked, and every miss turned into a finding about the cut.

packs.title: Visual and 3D rendering
packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for rendering images, motion graphics and 3D scenes and checking the results: renderer cards, scene, asset and motion recipes, quality checks with a contrast worked example, and verbs to plan, prepare, render, check and review.

packs.title: Voice narration
packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for narration with a text-to-speech voice: a pronunciation lexicon applied before synthesis and confirmed by ear, seeded takes logged with the exact text the model received, loudness, peak, noise-floor and pace measurements with a round-trip transcript check, takes chosen by a rule fixed in advance, lines placed on the beats they must fit, a person's listening check, and an AI-voice label wherever the voice plays.

packs.title: Wiring and conformance checks
packs.about: A collection of nouns and verbs for proving that a code project's capabilities are wired in: modules no live path imports, config fields that do not survive a save and reload, health probes that probe nothing, a canary for every rule so a check that stops firing is noticed, and documented behaviors whose only tests replace the real path with a mock; every gap recorded as a finding in the findings to fixes shape, with tested standard-library code that finds unused modules, mock-only tests and hol

kits.title: Multilingual Service Flyer Translation Check Kit
kits.about: Checks each translated service flyer against its English source for dropped facts, changed numbers, dates and phone numbers, untranslated text and reading level. A fluent community reviewer approves each language, and staff decide what gets printed and posted.

kits.title: Small-Nonprofit Restricted Grant & Audit Readiness Kit
kits.about: Reconciles ledger rows against restricted grant line items, lists missing receipt attachments as explicit nulls instead of zeros, and drafts narrative variance notes for treasurer review.

kits.title: Coerced Overseas Offer Helpline Directory & Safe Triage Kit
kits.about: Matches corridor countries and languages to re-verified public helplines and consular desks, surfacing unverified offer indicators while reserving all crisis safety planning for trained staff.

kits.title: Rental Deposit & Disaster-Relief Charity Registry Check Kit
kits.about: Compares rental deposit terms and disaster-relief charity appeals against published registry fields and statutory deposit caps, surfacing missing registration records while keeping all tenant counsel and regulator filings strictly human-only.

kits.title: Monthly Program Impact Report Kit
kits.about: Turns a month of program records into an impact report: totals by measure, change from last month, results against targets, and missing numbers kept as unknown. The program manager checks every figure, and the executive director approves the report and shares it.

kits.title: Community Services Warm-Referral & HSDS Triage Kit
kits.about: Matches Open Referral HSDS service listings against household needs, flags missing paperwork early, and drafts a plain-language warm-referral note for caseworker approval.

kits.title: Food Bank Inventory and Pickup Scheduling Kit
kits.about: Turns weekly stock counts into a restock and use-first list, and spreads booked pickup slots across volunteer shifts. Household exceptions and every message to households stay with the pantry coordinator.

kits.title: Policy Research Brief Kit
kits.about: Summarizes a new public rule or ordinance in plain language and cites the clause behind every point, lists dates and who the text says it covers, and marks what the text leaves unclear. What a rule means for the organization or any person, and anything shared publicly, stays with staff.

kits.title: Overseas Contract & Agency Fee Arithmetic Intake Kit
kits.about: Computes total placement fees as a share of first-month wages, flags contract pay reductions, and prepares a structured summary for a trained caseworker without accusing any party.

kits.title: Disaster Relief Volunteer Shift Schedule Kit
kits.about: Matches registered volunteers to posted relief tasks by skills, availability and required training, and drafts shift briefings with check-in and check-out steps. Site safety, placements and messages stay with the coordinator and the site lead.

kits.title: Funding Impact Summary for Grant Renewal Kit
kits.about: Summarizes what a grant paid for and achieved over its whole period for a renewal application: results against the original targets, spending by budget line from the finance lead's figures, and lessons staff name. Missing numbers stay unknown, and staff approve and submit.

kits.title: Community Pantry Shift Onboarding & Incident Escalation SOP Pack
kits.about: Standalone SOP playbook and multilingual role-card drafting skill for volunteer coordinators, reserving all medical, safety, and accommodation decisions strictly for the on-site shift captain.

kits.title: Victim Support Referral Options Kit
kits.about: Drafts referral options from a public services directory, filtered by service type, language, hours and access needs, and a plain referral checklist for advocates. Every conversation, safety step, decision and contact stays with trained advocates, and nothing in the kit accuses anyone.

kits.title: Donor Thank-You Letters with Privacy Checks Kit
kits.about: Drafts thank-you letters from a coded gift list with the acknowledgment details the finance lead requires, and checks that no letter exposes another donor's details or ignores a privacy choice. Staff decide special handling and sign and send every letter.

kits.title: Handwritten Statements to Text Kit
kits.about: Types handwritten statements and forms dropped into a folder exactly as written, keeping slang, spelling, acronyms and the writer's own words, and flags every uncertain reading for a person. A local acronym glossary helps readers but never changes the text, and a person checks every flag and signs off.

kits.title: Monthly program impact reporting process
kits.about: A reusable local tabular process for assembling monthly program impact numbers: it puts dates in one format, and writes a counts-only report. It runs on the organization's own computer or cloud account so files never leave it, and a person decides every flagged row or missing figure.

kits.title: Multilingual notice parity check process
kits.about: A reusable local tabular process for checking translated notice tables for missing fields and number parity: it puts dates in one format and puts phone numbers in one format, and writes a counts-only report. It runs on the organization's own computer or cloud account so files never leave it, and a person decides every flagged row or missing figure.

kits.title: Scanned document reading process
kits.about: A reusable process for scanned documents and handwritten notes. Your own agent or a local OCR tool reads each scan and saves one small reading file. The package's own runner stays on your computer and sends nothing: it checks those files against a field list, fills a spreadsheet and lists every unclear, low-confidence or missing field. It does not read images itself. A hosted agent model receives what it reads, so for client documents use a model that runs on your computer, or get a person's OK

kits.title: Public rule change register process
kits.about: A reusable local tabular process for checking public rule and effective-date tables for missing citations: it puts dates in one format, flags missing fields without guessing and flags verification and threshold gates for a person, and writes a counts-only report. It runs on the organization's own computer or cloud account so files never leave it, and a person decides every flagged row or missing figure.

kits.title: Volunteer shift roster and SOP check process
kits.about: A reusable local tabular process for preparing volunteer shift rosters and coverage checks: it puts dates in one format, flags missing fields without guessing and flags verification and threshold gates for a person, and writes a counts-only report. It runs on the organization's own computer or cloud account so files never leave it, and a person decides every flagged row or missing figure.

kits.title: Housing and charity register verification process
kits.about: A reusable local tabular process for checking housing and charity registry exports for missing registration details: it puts dates in one format, flags missing fields without guessing and flags verification and threshold gates for a person, and writes a counts-only report. It runs on the organization's own computer or cloud account so files never leave it, and a person decides every flagged row or missing figure.

kits.title: Support partner directory and referral readiness process
kits.about: A reusable local tabular process for checking partner service directories for capacity, languages and consent gates: it totals numeric measures against targets, and writes a counts-only report. It runs on the organization's own computer or cloud account so files never leave it, and a person decides every flagged row or missing figure.

kits.title: Statement transcription log and uncertain-passage check process
kits.about: A reusable local tabular process for indexing transcription log sheets and flagging uncertain passages for human review: it puts dates in one format, flags missing fields without guessing and flags verification and threshold gates for a person, and writes a counts-only report. It runs on the organization's own computer or cloud account so files never leave it, and a person decides every flagged row or missing figure.
